items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Well, he and Lips were my friends, and when I'd go up

ctx.x: He came to Cab Calloway's band, that's the reason I wanted to know. I'm trying to find ...

Well, he and Lips were my friends, and when I'd go up -- and Basie eventually asked me to sit in, I was scared to death, but I played a little. He wasn't too happy with his drummer. I'll give you his name later on, I can't think of it now. It's not Jo Jones, though.
This drummer you were speaking of -- you say it wasn't Jo Jones.
